definitions.gloss: beginning of the month; start of the month
definitions.explanation: The first few days of a calendar month. Used when referring to events, deadlines, or schedules at the start of a month.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}{初|はじ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's a meeting at the beginning of the month.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家賃|やちん}→家賃：03639_yachin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎月|まいつき}→毎月：00732_maitsuki⟧{月|つき}{初|はじ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{払|はら}います→払う：00535_harau⟧。
examples.english: I pay rent at the beginning of each month.

examples.japanese: {月|つき}{初|はじ}め⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{新|あたら}しい→新しい：00506_atarashii⟧⟦プロジェクト→プロジェクト：06764_purojekuto⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まる→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧で、⟦{準備|じゅんび}して→準備する：22427_junbisuru⟧おいて⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: A new project starts at the beginning of the month, so please prepare.

notes:
{月|つき}{初|はじ}め refers to the first few days of a calendar month, typically the first through fifth.

USAGE:
Often used with particles ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ or ⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ when specifying timing: {月|つき}{初|はじ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (at the beginning of the month), {月|つき}{初|はじ}め⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧ (from the beginning of the month).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {月|つき}{初|はじ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{届|とど}く→届く：00899_todoku⟧: to arrive at the beginning of the month
- {月|つき}{初|はじ}め⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{払|はら}う→払う：00535_harau⟧: to pay at the beginning of the month
- ⟦{来月|らいげつ}→来月：00744_raigetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{月|つき}{初|はじ}め: the beginning of next month

RELATED TIME EXPRESSIONS:
- {月|つき}{末|すえ}: end of the month
- ⟦{月|つき}{半|なか}ば→月半ば：27355_tsukinakaba⟧: middle of the month
- ⟦{月頭|げっとう}→月頭：15161_gettou⟧: beginning of the month (more formal, business-oriented)
- ⟦{上旬|じょうじゅん}→上旬：17767_joujun⟧: first third of the month (days 1-10)
